{{Quote|I'm sorry, Senator Braxis&mdash;The Imperial throne cannot interfere with local politics.''"<br />"''But you promised&mdash;|Galactic Emperor Palpatine and Senator Braxis speaking via hologram|<ref name="DT:PTN" />}}
'''Braxis''' was a [[Pho Ph'eahian]]<ref name="SW:CE" /> who served in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Senator/Legends|senator]] spoke to the newly declared head of the Empire, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the declaration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], while the latter was on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DT:PTN" /> During the exchange, Braxis sought aid for the [[Unidentified planet (Braxis)|planet]] he represented,<ref name="SW:CE" /> which Palpatine had previously promised him, though the Emperor denied the aid on the grounds that he could not intervene in local [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. Braxis protested, but was cut off before he could finish as the Emperor turned off the hologram.<ref name="DT:PTN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Braxis first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' in the [[Dark Times 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere|''Path to Nowhere'']] story arc<ref name="DT:PTN" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[November 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54075/star_wars_dark_times_2006_1|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #1}}</ref> The comic was written by Mick Harrison,<ref name="DT:PTN" /> a pen name of [[Randy Stradley]],<ref name="Insider 127">{{InsiderCite|127|Blaster}}</ref> and was illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]].<ref name="DT:PTN" />
